description: Installation of external wall insulation to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( (SK)005, (SK)006, (SK)007, (SK)008, (SK)009, (SK)010, (SK)021, (SK)022, (SK)023, (SK)024, (SK)025, (SK)026, (SK)027, (SK)028, (SK)030, (SK)031, (SK)032, (SK)033, Location Plan, Existing Block Plan, Flood Risk Assessment, Details on maintenance and renovation of facades with external wall insulation rendering coat instruction produced by Atlas, Information by Weatherby on Domestic Refurbishment, Agreement Certificate for use of the Atlas/Aval EPS External Wall Insulation Insulation System. Received: 15 January 2021 and 8 March 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until detailed design and method statements (in consultation with London Underground), have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority which:
